name: InvestorBench
description: InvestorBench is the first benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-based agents in diverse financial decision-making tasks across various financial products such as stocks, cryptocurrencies, and ETFs. It provides a comprehensive suite of tasks and multi-modal datasets to assess reasoning and decision-making capabilities of agents in different market environments.
reputation: A very recent finance-agent benchmark that is still early in adoption and has not yet become a standard reference point.
notes: Includes multi-modal datasets and environments for financial decision-making; evaluates 13 different LLM backbones.
